name: Triangle-Parallel Solid Voxelization
definition: A data-parallel algorithm for solid voxelization that parallelizes over all triangles, dedicating one thread per triangle.
summary: Triangle-Parallel Solid Voxelization is a data-parallel algorithm that maps triangle meshes to 3D voxel grids by assigning one thread per triangle, differing from voxel-parallel methods by parallelizing over input primitives.
